_readme: Curated registry. Every enabled entry was probed against the live backend and returned real jobs before being added (count in _verified). Ask Claude to 'add <company>' and it will inspect the careers page, identify the backend, verify it returns jobs, and append a working entry. adapter is one of: greenhouse, lever, ashby, workday, smartrecruiters, eightfold, oracle_ce, custom_json, custom_html.

companies.name: Atlassian
companies._note: Atlassian runs its own listings endpoint in front of iCIMS. Description is split across overview/responsibilities/qualifications, mapped as sections so 'Qualifications' feeds the required-skills bucket.

companies.name: ClickHouse
companies._note: Moved off Greenhouse - the old board token now 404s. Ashby board token is 'clickhouse'.

companies.name: Tekion
companies._note: Moved off Greenhouse - the old board token now 404s. Ashby board token is 'tekion'.

companies.name: PhonePe
companies._status: BLOCKED - the Greenhouse board token 'phonepe' now 404s and no replacement was found: the listing is client-side and the only backend hint is phonepe.darwinbox.in, for which there is no adapter. A failed fetch never closes jobs, so its stored rows went stale - clear them with --close-stale.

companies.name: Block
companies._note: Square, Cash App and Tidal all post under the one Block board.

companies.name: Marqeta
companies._note: The Greenhouse token now 404s; Marqeta serves its own list, server-rendered, whole board on one page. Each row is an <a> wrapping three cells: title, department, location. The description page has no dedicated container, so the detail selector grabs the page shell - nav and footer text comes along with it. Tailwind utility classes are the only hooks here, so a redesign will break these selectors.

companies.name: Wiz
companies._note: Board token is 'wizinc', not 'wiz'.

companies.name: HPE (incl. Juniper)
companies._note: Juniper Networks careers now redirect into HPE's Workday tenant after the acquisition.

companies.name: Visa
companies._note: usa.visa.com/careers is Akamai-protected and exposes nothing; the jobs themselves sit in this Workday tenant, site name 'Visa'.

companies.name: Cohesity
companies._note: cohesity.com/careers renders its list client-side; the Workday site name is Cohesity_Careers. Includes the Veritas roles post-merger.

companies.name: Broadcom (incl. VMware)
companies._note: VMware roles moved into Broadcom's Workday tenant after the acquisition.

companies.name: Cisco
companies._note: careers.cisco.com is a Phenom front end, but every posting's applyUrl points at this Workday tenant, so the workday adapter reads it directly. Splunk roles show under the same careers site post-acquisition.

companies.name: F5
companies._note: Workday tenant is 'ffive', not 'f5'.

companies.name: Swiggy
companies._verified: 6 jobs (most Swiggy roles are not on this board)

companies.name: Netflix
companies._note: Was blocked until the eightfold adapter existed. Descriptions come from the per-job detail call, not the list.

companies.name: American Express
companies._note: aexp.eightfold.ai answers but returns count=0 for every query - the real listing is Oracle Recruiting on pod egug.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com behind careers.americanexpress.com.

companies.name: Fortinet
companies._note: fortinet.com/careers redirects straight into Oracle Recruiting on pod edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com, site CX_2001.

companies.name: Nutanix
companies._note: careers.nutanix.com is a marketing shell; the board is Jobvite at jobs.jobvite.com/nutanix, which serves the whole list in one HTML table. Selectors are Jobvite's stable jv-* classes.

companies.name: Amazon
companies._note: amazon.jobs exposes search.json. Filtering is by exact normalized_location strings - add cities to that list as needed. basic_qualifications/preferred_qualifications map cleanly onto the required/preferred skill buckets.

companies.name: Google
companies._note: Google's results page is server-rendered, so no browser is needed - but the class names are build hashes (QJPWVe, r0wTof, lLd3Je) and will break on a redesign. If Google fetches 0 jobs, re-check these selectors first.

companies.name: Uber
companies._note: Left its own loadSearchJobsResults API (which now 404s) for Oracle Recruiting on pod iaziqy.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com. The old entry returned 18 titles with no descriptions; this returns the whole board with them.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies._status: BLOCKED - the API at gcsservices.careers.microsoft.com/search/api/v1/search resolves via Azure Front Door but every request fails to connect (curl exit before response, with and without browser headers). Likely TLS-fingerprint filtering.

companies.name: Apple
companies._status: BLOCKED - jobs.apple.com/api/role/search answers 301 to apple.com/pagenotfound for non-browser callers. Needs a real session and CSRF token.

companies.name: IBM
companies._status: BLOCKED - list renders client-side, and careers.ibm.com plus ibmglobal.avature.net answer 202 with an empty body (Akamai bot protection). Needs a real browser session.

companies.name: Goldman Sachs
companies._status: BLOCKED - higher.gs.com serves no job data or API reference in its HTML; the listing is fetched by an authenticated client-side call. Not on any public ATS.

companies.name: Intuit
companies._note: Radancy/TalentBrew board. Its /search-jobs/results endpoint answers JSON with an HTML fragment inside, which neither generic adapter can read, so this reads the server-rendered page instead: 15 jobs a page, 31 pages covers the whole board. data-job-id is unique per posting, unlike the repeated req ids on the li.

companies.name: D. E. Shaw
companies._status: BLOCKED - bespoke portal with no ATS marker. Note: the lever board 'dexterity' is a Redwood City robotics company, NOT D. E. Shaw - do not use it.

companies.name: Qualcomm
companies._status: BLOCKED - Eightfold tenant exists but the jobs API answers 403 {"message": "Not authorized for PCSX"}, so the public board is gated. The adapter config below is correct and only needs the gate lifted.

companies.name: Adtran
companies._note: Tenant and site are both the bare lowercase 'adtran'; the usual External/Careers site names 404 here.

companies.name: SolarWinds
companies._note: A SmartRecruiters board under the same name exists but carries a single stale posting; the greenhouse board is the live one.

companies.name: Cambium Networks
companies._note: Board is real but near-empty - one posting at the time of verification.

companies.name: Infoblox
companies._note: Oracle Fusion pod 'efpv' on us6; the careers page only links it from the apply button.

companies.name: Nokia
companies._status: BLOCKED - careers page ships no ATS marker and no Workday tenant/site combination answered. Infinera now redirects here, so Nokia covers that brand too.

companies.name: Akamai
companies._status: BLOCKED - listings render client-side with no ATS marker in the HTML; no Workday tenant/site combination answered.

companies.name: Check Point
companies._status: BLOCKED - bespoke portal, no ATS marker in the HTML and no Workday tenant/site combination answered.

companies.name: Gigamon
companies._status: BLOCKED - runs on Jobvite (jobs.jobvite.com/gigamon) and there is no jobvite adapter yet.

companies.name: Keysight
companies._status: BLOCKED - iCIMS backend; no icims adapter yet. Same for Riverbed (careers-riverbed.icims.com) and CommScope (SuccessFactors).

companies.name: Corelight
companies._note: Greenhouse board reports the generic name 'Job Board'; the token and postings are Corelight's.

companies.name: GreyNoise
companies._note: Greenhouse token is 'greynoiseintelligence'; the short 'greynoise' is not a board.

companies.name: Opal Security
companies._note: Ashby token is the bare 'opal'; the board is Opal Security (identity governance), not the camera company of the same name.

companies.name: Teleport
companies._note: Ashby token is 'goteleport', not 'teleport'.

companies.name: Armis
companies._note: SmartRecruiters board is sparse - most Armis roles are posted elsewhere, so treat this as a partial view.

companies.name: Vectra AI
companies._note: Board token is the old company name 'vectranetworks'; 'vectra' is not a board.

companies.name: ExtraHop
companies._note: Board token is 'extrahopnetworks', not 'extrahop'.

companies.name: Darktrace
companies._note: The Workday site name is misspelled on Darktrace's side - 'DarktaceExternal', no 'r'. Spelling it correctly 404s.

companies.name: Exabeam
companies._status: BLOCKED - runs on Jobvite (jobs.jobvite.com/exabeam) and there is no jobvite adapter yet. Same backend as Gigamon.

companies.name: Cyera
companies._status: BLOCKED - runs on Comeet (comeet.com/jobs/cyera/17.008) and there is no comeet adapter yet.

companies.name: Aqua Security
companies._status: BLOCKED - runs on Comeet, same as Cyera; needs a comeet adapter.
